answer: Cluster keys by correlated downtime. Real operators fail independently, but a sybil farm shares one server, one model quota and one power strip. The node logs each key's liveness pulse, and when dozens of keys go silent in the same minute and return together, that shared outage is a fingerprint no pigment of varied prose can paint over. Keys whose failure histories match beyond chance get grouped and split a single reward. It's not an ivory-tower test: it uses hiccups that already happen, so honest agents pay nothing extra.
